family_directives.objective: Investigate ranking-objective formulations in depth. Use the prior campaign results to choose a distinct next pairwise, listwise, or hybrid formulation and its sampling, weighting, capacity, regularization, and optimization hyperparameters. Prefer a targeted refinement of promising evidence or a falsifying alternative to a failed hypothesis; do not repeat a prior design.
family_directives.temporal_history: Investigate strictly past user-history modeling in depth. Use the prior campaign results to choose a distinct next representation, entity affinity, sequence horizon, recency weighting, positive-negative evidence treatment, shrinkage, residual scale, and related hyperparameters. Prefer a targeted refinement of promising evidence or a falsifying alternative to a failed hypothesis; do not repeat a prior design.
